name: GET /api/leadflow/audit/timeline - the correlated narrative
description:
One subject's history, correlated.

A NARRATIVE, NOT A LOG TAIL. Events are returned with their correlation so a reader sees "this lead arrived, was routed, was messaged, and the message was suppressed" as one story rather than four rows they must join in their head — and that joining is exactly where a reader gets the story wrong.

An unreachable audit service reports the history as UNKNOWN: an empty timeline and an unreachable one look identical, and only one of them means nothing happened to this person.

testCases.name: The timeline returns correlated entries with upstream reachability
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.when: the subject_ref query parameter is absent.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
